_comment: SelfPhotos Adjust's Auto: how one tap sets the sliders from the photo (web: adjust-auto.ts; Android: adjust_auto.dart reads this same file through mobile/assets/selfphotos/adjust-auto.json). Tones are 0..1 as shown on screen (sRGB), shares are 0..1 of the photo, slider values -1..1 as adjust-core.glsl takes them. adjust-auto-parity.json has pictures and the values both apps must give for them.
